stories.title: Path 1: Central Trend Execution — International Direct-to-Consumer Scaling & Americas Assortment Stabilization
stories.short_summary: Lululemon stabilizes North American comps through product novelty restoration while scaling international DTC at 18%-20%, driving revenue to $13,626M and Owner Earnings per share to $20.41 by Year 5.

stories.story_title: Path 2: Downside Friction & Headwinds — North American Product Fatigue, Promotional Liquidation & Tariff Squeeze
stories.title: Path 2: Downside Friction & Headwinds — North American Product Fatigue, Promotional Liquidation & Tariff Squeeze
stories.short_summary: North American brand fatigue, heightened competition from Alo and Vuori, and unmitigated tariff headwinds compress gross margins to 53.0% and operating margins to 15.2% by Year 3, driving Owner Earnings down to $8.35/share by Year 5.
stories.summary: North American brand fatigue, heightened competition from Alo and Vuori, and unmitigated tariff headwinds compress gross margins to 53.0% and operating margins to 15.2% by Year 3, driving Owner Earnings down to $8.35/share by Year 5.

stories.short_summary: Accelerated Greater China expansion, Men's category market penetration, and tariff duty clawbacks drive revenue to $15.9B and operating margins to 23.5% by Year 5, with disciplined share repurchases compounding owner earnings per share at a 20.0% CAGR.
stories.summary: Accelerated Greater China expansion, Men's category market penetration, and tariff duty clawbacks drive revenue to $15.9B and operating margins to 23.5% by Year 5, with disciplined share repurchases compounding owner earnings per share at a 20.0% CAGR.
